SMK Lab is a directory and landing page by Chance Roth (@ChanceTheMaker). It brings together independent custom firmware and browser projects for M-VAVE SMK-37 Pro & Elite.

Firmware projects

  • Felucca SMK is based on Felucca by Leo Kuroshita (@kurogedelic), Hügelton Instruments.
  • Sloop SMK is based on Sloop by isod89, itself based on Felucca.
  • Melodee SMK adapts Melodee by keremimo / Ellic Studio, based on Felucca. Studio and Simulator are available as a browser preview; the hardware port remains in development.
  • Doom FM-1 / SMK is a DoomGeneric port with an original campaign by Chance Roth, using credited Miniwad and Freedoom assets. See its project credits. The angular Doom FM-1 / SMK wordmark is original SVG artwork by Chance Roth. The black SMK illustration includes an actual game screenshot. Its Miniwad and Freedoom artwork retains the Miniwad license, Freedoom license and contributor credits.

Artwork and site source

SMK illustrations and Studio screenshots are adapted from the Felucca SMK, Sloop SMK and Melodee SMK sites by Chance Roth. The illustrations are presentation artwork, not physical measurements. This site's source is distributed under GPL-3.0. Each linked project retains its own licenses and credits.

Fonts

Racing Sans One and Righteous are redistributed with their Racing Sans One license and Righteous license. Body text uses system fonts.

Independence

M-VAVE and SMK-37 are trademarks of their respective owners. SMK Lab is an independent project, not an official manufacturer website.

Privacy and submissions

This hub does not run analytics or request MIDI access. The submission form only opens GitHub with the information you enter. You must sign in and submit there; requests are public and subject to GitHub's policies. This hub does not automatically list submitted sites. Linked sites have their own privacy practices.
